rv.q: The bells, whistles and strangers in your group really do elevate the Live Experience into something more than a cynical tie-ie.
I can safely say I have never enjoyed an experience I have attended quite as much as I did this.
I absolutely loved every moment of The Traitors: Live Experience London.
The interactive game based on BBC One’s reality show is surprisingly exhilarating.
It did feel like we were filming an episode of the TV show, with contestants fully getting wrapped up in the concept and trying to throw one another under the bus.

cn.t: Critics praise The Traitors: Live Experience as a thrilling, addictive adaptation that successfully captures the psychological tension and backstabbing intrigue of the hit TV show, delivering an exhilarating immersive adventure for fans.
